name: Chladni Cymatics
desc: Cymatic Chladni figures — sand settling on the nodal lines of a vibrating plate as superposed standing-wave modes beat against each other, the resonance web perpetually morphing to finer symmetric lattices as the driving frequency climbs; renders as gold sand on indigo, phosphor oscilloscope, spectral-tinted plate, ferrofluid, or black sand on cream.

scale.doc: plate frequency / mode numbers (higher = finer figures)

density.doc: number of superposed modes (more = busier interference)
